changeSet.author: business-team
changeSet.sql: UPDATE currency_rates cr SET effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM temp_currency_rates tr WHERE cr.currency_code = tr.currency_code AND cr.effective_to IS NULL AND ( cr.rate != tr.rate OR cr.decimals != tr.decimals OR cr.description != tr.description OR cr.is_active != tr.is_active );

INSERT INTO currency_rates (currency_code, rate, decimals, is_active, description, created_by, effective_from) SELECT tr.currency_code, tr.rate, tr.decimals, tr.is_active, tr.description, tr.created_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM temp_currency_rates tr JOIN currency_rates cr ON cr.currency_code = tr.currency_code WHERE cr.effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

INSERT INTO currency_rates (currency_code, rate, decimals, is_active, description, created_by, effective_from) SELECT tr.currency_code, tr.rate, tr.decimals, tr.is_active, tr.description, tr.created_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM temp_currency_rates tr WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM currency_rates cr WHERE cr.currency_code = tr.currency_code );

UPDATE currency_rates cr SET effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_active = false WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM temp_currency_rates tr WHERE tr.currency_code = cr.currency_code ) AND cr.effective_to IS NULL;
